idem: question_set:Q:{"text": "Why does Tesla report revenue under two different XBRL concepts, and which one should be used for which years?"}

payload.text: Why does Tesla report revenue under two different XBRL concepts, and which one should be used for which years?

idem: hypothesis_proposed:H-3b9440:{"how_to_test": "SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(*) AS fact_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period; This will show which concept appears in each period and whether there is a clear transition year.", "text": "Tesla initially reported revenue using the legacy US\u2011GAAP concept 'Revenues' and later adopted the newer ASC\u202f606 concept 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' after the revenue recognition standard change, so the concept used shifts over time."}

payload.text: Tesla initially reported revenue using the legacy US‑GAAP concept 'Revenues' and later adopted the newer ASC 606 concept 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' after the revenue recognition standard change, so the concept used shifts over time.
payload.how_to_test: SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(*) AS fact_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period; This will show which concept appears in each period and whether there is a clear transition year.

idem: hypothesis_proposed:H-d0b0d7:{"how_to_test": "SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) AS filing_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) > 1; This identifies periods where the same concept appears in multiple filings, suggesting amendment duplication.", "text": "Both concepts are reported simultaneously for the same period because Tesla files both an original 10-K/10-Q and an amended filing (10-K/A or 10-Q/A) that re\u2011tags the same underlying number with the newer concept, creating duplicate facts."}

payload.text: Both concepts are reported simultaneously for the same period because Tesla files both an original 10-K/10-Q and an amended filing (10-K/A or 10-Q/A) that re‑tags the same underlying number with the newer concept, creating duplicate facts.
payload.how_to_test: SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) AS filing_cnt FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT accession_number) > 1; This identifies periods where the same concept appears in multiple filings, suggesting amendment duplication.

idem: hypothesis_proposed:H-e2ec90:{"how_to_test": "SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, SUM(value_usd) AS total_rev FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept; Comparing the summed values for each concept within the same period will reveal if they differ systematically (e.g., tax amount).", "text": "The dual concepts reflect different revenue scopes: 'Revenues' captures total GAAP revenue, while 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' isolates revenue from customer contracts excluding sales tax, allowing analysts to view both gross and tax\u2011excluded figures."}

payload.text: The dual concepts reflect different revenue scopes: 'Revenues' captures total GAAP revenue, while 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' isolates revenue from customer contracts excluding sales tax, allowing analysts to view both gross and tax‑excluded figures.

idem: hypothesis_proposed:H-5e94de:{"how_to_test": "SELECT cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept, COUNT(*) AS fact_cnt, MIN(filed_date) AS earliest_filing, MAX(filed_date) AS latest_filing FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact WHERE cik = '1318605' GROUP BY cik, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, concept ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period; Look for periods where both concepts appear but the later filing dates show only one concept persisting, indicating a correction over time.", "text": "Early XBRL instance documents contained tagging errors where both concepts were mistakenly applied to the same fact due to taxonomy mapping issues, and later corrections removed the erroneous tag, leaving a mix of correct and incorrect facts in the historical data."}
